steps.name: Fetch and verify pinned official c2patool release
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl --fail --location --silent --show-error \
  "https://github.com/contentauth/c2pa-rs/releases/download/c2patool-v0.27.22/c2patool-v0.27.22-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" \
  --output .tmp/fr172/c2patool.tar.gz

steps.name: Exercise exact c2patool on official public C2PA fixture
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl --fail --location --silent --show-error \
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/contentauth/c2pa-rs/c2patool-v0.27.22/sdk/tests/fixtures/C.jpg" \
  --output .tmp/fr172/C.jpg
FIXTURE_SHA="$(git hash-object .tmp/fr172/C.jpg)"
echo "fixture=$FIXTURE_SHA"
test "$FIXTURE_SHA" = "b6579b3281fbd448163f77fe46bf8d24f3e5a018"
set +e
"$C2PATOOL_BIN" .tmp/fr172/C.jpg > .tmp/fr172/C.validation.json 2> .tmp/fr172/C.validation.stderr
C2PA_EXIT=$?
set -e
echo "public fixture c2patool exit=$C2PA_EXIT"
test -s .tmp/fr172/C.validation.json
node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
const parsed = JSON.parse(readFileSync('.tmp/fr172/C.validation.json', 'utf8'));
if (typeof parsed.active_manifest !== 'string' || parsed.active_manifest.length === 0) throw new Error('missing active_manifest');
if (!parsed.manifests || typeof parsed.manifests !== 'object' || !(parsed.active_manifest in parsed.manifests)) throw new Error('active manifest is not resolvable');
if (!['Trusted', 'Valid', 'Invalid'].includes(parsed.validation_state)) throw new Error(`unexpected validation_state ${parsed.validation_state}`);
if (!parsed.validation_results || typeof parsed.validation_results !== 'object') throw new Error('missing validation_results');

steps.name: Authenticate to Google Cloud using Workload Identity Federation
Collect sanitized service lineage evidence
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
evidence_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-cloud-run-lineage-evidence"
service_raw="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-service-raw.json"
revision_names="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-revision-names.txt"
revision_ndjson="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-revisions-sanitized.ndjson"
audit_raw="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-audit-raw.json"
audit_error="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-audit-error.txt"
audit_safe="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-audit-sanitized.json"
evidence_json="${evidence_dir}/saju-production-cloud-run-lineage-evidence.json"
evidence_md="${evidence_dir}/saju-production-cloud-run-lineage-evidence.md"
mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"
: > "$revision_ndjson"

captured_at="$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"

gcloud run services describe "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" \
  --region "$GCP_REGION" \
  --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
  --format=json > "$service_raw"

gcloud run revisions list \
  --service "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" \
  --region "$GCP_REGION" \
  --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
  --format='value(metadata.name)' > "$revision_names"

if [ ! -s "$revision_names" ]; then
  echo 'No Cloud Run revisions were returned for the configured Production service.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

while IFS= read -r revision; do
  [ -n "$revision" ] || continue
  gcloud run revisions describe "$revision" \
    --region "$GCP_REGION" \
    --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
    --format=json \
    | jq -c '{
        name: (.metadata.name // ""),
        createdAtUtc: (.metadata.creationTimestamp // ""),
        imageRef: (.spec.containers[0].image // ""),
        ready: ([.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Ready") | .status][0] // "")
      }' >> "$revision_ndjson"
done < "$revision_names"

audit_filter="protoPayload.serviceName=\"run.googleapis.com\" AND (protoPayload.resourceName:\"/services/${GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE}\" OR resource.labels.service_name=\"${GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE}\")"
if gcloud logging read "$audit_filter" \
  --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
  --freshness=30d \
  --limit=500 \
  --order=asc \
  --format=json > "$audit_raw" 2> "$audit_error"; then
  audit_readable=true
  audit_category='readable'
  audit_exit_code=0
  jq '[.[] | {
      timestamp: (.timestamp // .receiveTimestamp // ""),
      methodName: (.protoPayload.methodName // ""),
      resourceName: (.protoPayload.resourceName // ""),
      requestTraffic: (.protoPayload.request.spec.traffic // .protoPayload.request.traffic // []),
      responseTraffic: (.protoPayload.response.status.traffic // []),
      responseLatestReadyRevisionName: (.protoPayload.response.status.latestReadyRevisionName // "")
    }]
    | map(select(
        (.requestTraffic | length) > 0
        or (.responseTraffic | length) > 0
        or (.methodName | test("CreateService|UpdateService|ReplaceService"))
      ))' "$audit_raw" > "$audit_safe"
else
  audit_exit_code=$?
  audit_readable=false
  audit_category='provider_read_failed'
  if grep -Eqi 'does not have permission|permission denied|PERMISSION_DENIED' "$audit_error"; then
    audit_category='permission_denied'
  elif grep -Eqi 'not found|does not exist' "$audit_error"; then
    audit_category='resource_not_found_or_hidden'
  fi
  printf '[]\n' > "$audit_safe"
fi

jq -s '.' "$revision_ndjson" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-revisions-sanitized.json"

jq -n \
  --arg capturedAt "$captured_at" \
  --arg projectId "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
  --arg region "$GCP_REGION" \
  --arg service "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" \
  --arg auditCategory "$audit_category" \
  --argjson auditReadable "$audit_readable" \
  --argjson auditExitCode "$audit_exit_code" \
  --slurpfile serviceDoc "$service_raw" \
  --slurpfile revisions "${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-revisions-sanitized.json" \
  --slurpfile auditEvents "$audit_safe" '
    ($serviceDoc[0] // {}) as $serviceDoc |
    ($revisions[0] // []) as $revisions |
    ($auditEvents[0] // []) as $auditEvents |
    [($serviceDoc.status.traffic[]? | {
      revisionName: (.revisionName // ""),
      percent: (.percent // 0),
      tag: (.tag // ""),
      latestRevision: (.latestRevision // false)
    }) | select(.percent > 0)] as $activeTraffic |
    ($activeTraffic | map(.percent) | add // 0) as $trafficTotal |
    {
      schemaVersion: 1,
      capturedAtUtc: $capturedAt,
      target: {
        projectId: $projectId,
        region: $region,
        service: $service,
        serviceUrl: ($serviceDoc.status.url // ""),
        generation: ($serviceDoc.metadata.generation // null),
        observedGeneration: ($serviceDoc.status.observedGeneration // null),
        latestCreatedRevisionName: ($serviceDoc.status.latestCreatedRevisionName // ""),
        latestReadyRevisionName: ($serviceDoc.status.latestReadyRevisionName // ""),
        activeTraffic: $activeTraffic,
        activeTrafficPercentTotal: $trafficTotal
      },
      revisionInventory: $revisions,
      auditHistory: {
        freshnessDays: 30,
        limit: 500,
        readable: $auditReadable,
        category: $auditCategory,
        exitCode: $auditExitCode,
        rawProviderDataRetained: false,
        selectedTrafficEvents: $auditEvents
      },
      classification: {
        revisionInventoryCount: ($revisions | length),
        selectedTrafficEventCount: ($auditEvents | length),
        singleActiveRevisionAt100Percent: (($activeTraffic | length) == 1 and $trafficTotal == 100),
        rollbackTargetAuthorized: false,
        predecessorInferenceFromRevisionOrderingAllowed: false
      },
      nonClaims: [
        "Revision creation ordering is not evidence of prior serving traffic.",
        "A prior rollback target is not authorized unless direct traffic-history evidence identifies it.",
        "Audit-log read failure is not evidence that no traffic history exists.",
        "Raw service, revision, audit-log, and provider-error payloads are intentionally excluded from the artifact.",
        "This workflow performs no Cloud Run deployment, traffic, IAM, Secret Manager, Logging, or Monitoring mutation."
      ]
    }
  ' > "$evidence_json"

selected_event_count="$(jq -r '.classification.selectedTrafficEventCount' "$evidence_json")"
active_100="$(jq -r '.classification.singleActiveRevisionAt100Percent' "$evidence_json")"

{
  echo '## Saju Production Cloud Run lineage evidence'
  echo
  echo "- captured UTC: \`$(jq -r '.capturedAtUtc' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- project: \`$(jq -r '.target.projectId' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- service: \`$(jq -r '.target.service' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- active traffic: \`$(jq -c '.target.activeTraffic' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- latest ready revision: \`$(jq -r '.target.latestReadyRevisionName' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- revision inventory count: \`$(jq -r '.classification.revisionInventoryCount' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- audit history readable: \`$(jq -r '.auditHistory.readable' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- audit history category: \`$(jq -r '.auditHistory.category' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- selected traffic events: \`${selected_event_count}\`"

  echo '### Boundary'

  echo '- raw provider payloads and raw provider errors are not retained'

} > "$evidence_md"

rm -f "$service_raw" "$revision_names" "$revision_ndjson" \

source_deployment_run_id.description: Successful Production Cloud Run run whose rollback manifest is authoritative

steps.name: Preflight destructive rollback-drill inputs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

[[ "$GITHUB_REF" == 'refs/heads/main' ]]
[[ "$CONFIRMATION" == 'RUN_PRODUCTION_ROLLBACK_DRILL' ]]
[[ "$MYEONGHA_WATCHTOWER_TRACK" == 'ops' ]]
[[ "$SOURCE_DEPLOYMENT_RUN_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
[[ "$ACTIVE_BEARER_VERSION" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]

for name in             GCP_PROJECT_ID             GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER             GCP_DEPLOYER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT             GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE             GCP_SAJU_ACTIVE_BEARER_SECRET
do
  [[ -n "${!name:-}" ]] || {
    echo "Missing required production rollback variable: $name" >&2
    exit 1
  }
done

[[ "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" =~ ^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$ ]]

steps.name: Resolve exact authoritative rollback artifact
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

source_run="$(gh api "/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$SOURCE_DEPLOYMENT_RUN_ID")"
jq -e '
  .name == "Production Cloud Run"
  and .path == ".github/workflows/production-cloud-run.yml"
  and .event == "workflow_dispatch"
  and .head_branch == "main"
  and .status == "completed"
  and .conclusion == "success"
  and .repository.full_name == env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY
' <<<"$source_run" >/dev/null

source_attempt="$(jq -er '.run_attempt' <<<"$source_run")"
[[ "$source_attempt" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
expected_name="production-cloud-run-rollback-$SOURCE_DEPLOYMENT_RUN_ID-$source_attempt"

artifacts="$(gh api "/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$SOURCE_DEPLOYMENT_RUN_ID/artifacts?per_page=100")"
selected="$(jq -c --arg name "$expected_name" '
  [
    .artifacts[]
    | select(.name == $name and (.expired == false))
  ]
' <<<"$artifacts")"
[[ "$(jq 'length' <<<"$selected")" == '1' ]]

artifact_id="$(jq -er '.[0].id' <<<"$selected")"
artifact_name="$(jq -er '.[0].name' <<<"$selected")"
[[ "$artifact_id" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]

echo "artifact_id=$artifact_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "artifact_name=$artifact_name" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "source_attempt=$source_attempt" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Authenticate to Google Cloud using Workload Identity Federation
Validate rollback authority and current traffic
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

mapfile -t manifests < <(
  find "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-authority" -type f -name 'production-rollback-manifest.json' -print
)
[[ "${#manifests[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
manifest="${manifests[0]}"

jq -e             --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"             --arg project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --arg region "$GCP_REGION"             --arg service "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE"             --arg run_id "$SOURCE_DEPLOYMENT_RUN_ID"             --arg run_attempt "$SOURCE_ATTEMPT" '
    .schemaVersion == 1
    and .evidenceClass == "pre_deploy_rollback_manifest"
    and .target.projectId == $project
    and .target.region == $region
    and .target.service == $service
    and .source.repository == $repository
    and .source.runId == $run_id
    and .source.runAttempt == $run_attempt
    and .activeTrafficPercentTotal == 100
    and .classification.exactServingTrafficCaptured == true
    and .classification.everyServingRevisionReady == true
    and .classification.everyServingRevisionImageDigestQualified == true
    and .classification.predecessorInferenceFromRevisionOrderingAllowed == false
    and .classification.productionTrafficMutatedByThisCapture == false
    and (.activeTraffic | length) == 1
    and .activeTraffic[0].percent == 100
    and (.servingRevisions | length) == 1
    and .servingRevisions[0].ready == true
    and .servingRevisions[0].revisionName == .activeTraffic[0].revisionName
    and (.servingRevisions[0].imageRef | test("@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"))
  ' "$manifest" >/dev/null

rollback_revision="$(jq -er '.activeTraffic[0].revisionName' "$manifest")"
rollback_image="$(jq -er '.servingRevisions[0].imageRef' "$manifest")"
service_url="$(jq -er '.target.serviceUrl' "$manifest")"
[[ "$rollback_revision" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$ ]]
[[ "$service_url" =~ ^https://[^/]+$ ]]

rollback_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-target-revision.json"
gcloud run revisions describe "$rollback_revision"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$rollback_json"

[[ "$(jq -r '[.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Ready") | .status] | .[0] // empty' "$rollback_json")" == 'True' ]]
[[ "$(jq -r '.spec.containers[0].image // empty' "$rollback_json")" == "$rollback_image" ]]

current_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/current-service.json"
gcloud run services describe "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$current_json"

current_count="$(jq '[.status.traffic[]? | select((.percent // 0) > 0 and (.revisionName // "") != "")] | length' "$current_json")"
[[ "$current_count" == '1' ]]
current_revision="$(jq -er '.status.traffic[] | select((.percent // 0) == 100) | .revisionName' "$current_json")"
current_service_url="$(jq -er '.status.url' "$current_json")"
[[ "$current_service_url" == "$service_url" ]]
[[ "$current_revision" != "$rollback_revision" ]]

current_revision_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/current-revision.json"
gcloud run revisions describe "$current_revision"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$current_revision_json"

[[ "$(jq -r '[.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Ready") | .status] | .[0] // empty' "$current_revision_json")" == 'True' ]]
current_image="$(jq -er '.spec.containers[0].image' "$current_revision_json")"
[[ "$current_image" =~ @sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]

state_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill"
mkdir -p "$state_dir"
jq -n             --arg schemaVersion "saju-production-cloud-run-rollback-drill-evidence/v1"             --arg capturedAtUtc "$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"             --argjson sourceDeploymentRunId "$SOURCE_DEPLOYMENT_RUN_ID"             --argjson sourceDeploymentRunAttempt "$SOURCE_ATTEMPT"             --argjson rollbackManifestArtifactId "$ARTIFACT_ID"             --arg rollbackManifestArtifactName "$ARTIFACT_NAME"             --arg service "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE"             --arg serviceUrl "$service_url"             --arg rollbackRevision "$rollback_revision"             --arg rollbackImageRef "$rollback_image"             --arg originalRevision "$current_revision"             --arg originalImageRef "$current_image" '
    {
      schemaVersion: $schemaVersion,
      capturedAtUtc: $capturedAtUtc,
      sourceDeploymentRunId: $sourceDeploymentRunId,
      sourceDeploymentRunAttempt: $sourceDeploymentRunAttempt,
      rollbackManifestArtifactId: $rollbackManifestArtifactId,
      rollbackManifestArtifactName: $rollbackManifestArtifactName,
      target: {
        service: $service,
        serviceUrl: $serviceUrl
      },
      rollbackTarget: {
        revision: $rollbackRevision,
        imageRef: $rollbackImageRef,
        ready: true,
        manifestBound: true
      },
      originalServing: {
        revision: $originalRevision,
        imageRef: $originalImageRef,
        percent: 100,
        ready: true
      },
      rollback: {
        attempted: false,
        trafficVerified: false,
        authenticatedSmokePassed: false
      },
      restoration: {
        attempted: false,
        trafficVerified: false,
        authenticatedSmokePassed: false
      },
      classification: {
        predecessorInferredFromRevisionOrdering: false,
        secretValuesRetained: false,
        rawProviderPayloadsRetained: false,
        productionTrafficMutationAuthorizedByConfirmation: true,
        finalOriginalTrafficRequired: true
      }
    }
  ' > "$state_dir/evidence.json"

echo "rollback_revision=$rollback_revision" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "rollback_image=$rollback_image" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "original_revision=$current_revision" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "original_image=$current_image" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "service_url=$service_url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Read active service credential
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
bearer="$(gcloud secrets versions access "$ACTIVE_BEARER_VERSION"             --secret "$GCP_SAJU_ACTIVE_BEARER_SECRET"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID")"
[[ -n "$bearer" ]]
[[ ! "$bearer" =~ [[:space:]] ]]
echo "::add-mask::$bearer"
printf '%s' "$bearer" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill-bearer"
chmod 600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill-bearer"

steps.name: Switch 100 percent traffic to manifest rollback revision
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
echo "attempted=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "started_epoch=$(date +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

jq '.rollback.attempted = true | .rollback.switchStartedAtUtc = (now | todateiso8601)'             "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.json"             > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.next.json"
mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.next.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.json"

gcloud run services update-traffic "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --to-revisions "$ROLLBACK_REVISION=100"             --quiet

steps.name: Verify rollback traffic and authenticated smoke
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

service_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill-service.json"
gcloud run services describe "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$service_json"

jq -e --arg revision "$ROLLBACK_REVISION" '
  ([.status.traffic[]? | select((.percent // 0) > 0)] | length) == 1
  and ([.status.traffic[]? | select(.revisionName == $revision and (.percent // 0) == 100)] | length) == 1
' "$service_json" >/dev/null

bearer="$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill-bearer")"
echo "::add-mask::$bearer"

SAJU_SMOKE_BASE_URL="$SERVICE_URL"           SAJU_SMOKE_BEARER="$bearer"           SAJU_SMOKE_TIMEOUT_MS='30000'             node scripts/verify-production-calculation-service.mjs

SAJU_SMOKE_BASE_URL="$SERVICE_URL"           SAJU_SMOKE_BEARER="$bearer"           SAJU_SMOKE_TIMEOUT_MS='30000'             node scripts/verify-preview-reading-service.mjs

duration="$(( $(date +%s) - STARTED_EPOCH ))"
jq             --arg completed "$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"             --argjson duration "$duration"             '.rollback.trafficVerified = true
   | .rollback.authenticatedSmokePassed = true
   | .rollback.completedAtUtc = $completed
   | .rollback.durationSeconds = $duration'             "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.json"             > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.next.json"
mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.next.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.json"

steps.name: Restore original production traffic
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

jq '.restoration.attempted = true | .restoration.switchStartedAtUtc = (now | todateiso8601)'             "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.json"             > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.next.json"
mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.next.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.json"

gcloud run services update-traffic "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --to-revisions "$ORIGINAL_REVISION=100"             --quiet

steps.name: Verify original traffic restored and smoke again
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

service_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/final-service.json"
revision_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/final-revision.json"

gcloud run services describe "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$service_json"

jq -e --arg revision "$ORIGINAL_REVISION" '
  ([.status.traffic[]? | select((.percent // 0) > 0)] | length) == 1
  and ([.status.traffic[]? | select(.revisionName == $revision and (.percent // 0) == 100)] | length) == 1
' "$service_json" >/dev/null

gcloud run revisions describe "$ORIGINAL_REVISION"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$revision_json"
[[ "$(jq -r '.spec.containers[0].image // empty' "$revision_json")" == "$ORIGINAL_IMAGE" ]]

bearer="$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill-bearer")"
echo "::add-mask::$bearer"

SAJU_SMOKE_BASE_URL="$SERVICE_URL"           SAJU_SMOKE_BEARER="$bearer"           SAJU_SMOKE_TIMEOUT_MS='30000'             node scripts/verify-production-calculation-service.mjs

SAJU_SMOKE_BASE_URL="$SERVICE_URL"           SAJU_SMOKE_BEARER="$bearer"           SAJU_SMOKE_TIMEOUT_MS='30000'             node scripts/verify-preview-reading-service.mjs

jq             --arg completed "$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"             '.restoration.trafficVerified = true
   | .restoration.authenticatedSmokePassed = true
   | .restoration.completedAtUtc = $completed
   | .finalState = {
       originalTrafficRestored: true,
       productionSmokePassed: true,
       rollbackDrillPassed: (
         .rollback.trafficVerified == true
         and .rollback.authenticatedSmokePassed == true
       )
     }'             "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.json"             > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.next.json"
mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.next.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.json"

steps.name: Require successful rollback and final restoration
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
jq -e '
  .rollback.attempted == true
  and .rollback.trafficVerified == true
  and .rollback.authenticatedSmokePassed == true
  and .restoration.attempted == true
  and .restoration.trafficVerified == true
  and .restoration.authenticatedSmokePassed == true
  and .finalState.originalTrafficRestored == true
  and .finalState.productionSmokePassed == true
  and .finalState.rollbackDrillPassed == true
  and .classification.secretValuesRetained == false
  and .classification.rawProviderPayloadsRetained == false
' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rollback-drill/evidence.json" >/dev/null

workflows.name: Production Cloud Run Routing Diagnostics

candidate_tag.description: Existing Cloud Run traffic tag to inspect

diagnose.name: Inspect candidate control plane and HTTP routing

steps.name: Validate diagnostic inputs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
required_vars=(
  GCP_PROJECT_ID
  GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER
  GCP_DEPLOYER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
  GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE
  CANDIDATE_TAG
)
for name in "${required_vars[@]}"; do
  if [ -z "${!name:-}" ]; then
    echo "Missing required diagnostic value: ${name}." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
if [[ ! "$CANDIDATE_TAG" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$ ]]; then
  echo 'candidate_tag is not a valid Cloud Run traffic tag.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Authenticate to Google Cloud using Workload Identity Federation
Inspect Cloud Run routing and probe HTTP endpoints
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

service_json="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-service.json"
revision_json="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cloud-run-revision.json"
gcloud run services describe "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" \
  --region "$GCP_REGION" \
  --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
  --format=json > "$service_json"

echo '=== Cloud Run service control-plane snapshot ==='
jq '{
  name: .metadata.name,
  url: .status.url,
  latestCreatedRevisionName: .status.latestCreatedRevisionName,
  latestReadyRevisionName: .status.latestReadyRevisionName,
  traffic: [.status.traffic[]? | {
    tag: (.tag // null),
    revisionName: (.revisionName // null),
    percent: (.percent // 0),
    url: (.url // null),
    latestRevision: (.latestRevision // false)
  }]
}' "$service_json"

candidate_revision="$(jq -r --arg tag "$CANDIDATE_TAG" '.status.traffic[]? | select(.tag == $tag) | (.revisionName // empty)' "$service_json" | head -n 1)"
candidate_url="$(jq -r --arg tag "$CANDIDATE_TAG" '.status.traffic[]? | select(.tag == $tag) | (.url // empty)' "$service_json" | head -n 1)"
service_url="$(jq -r '.status.url // empty' "$service_json")"

if [ -z "$candidate_revision" ] || [ -z "$candidate_url" ]; then
  echo "Candidate tag '$CANDIDATE_TAG' does not resolve to both revisionName and url." >&2
  exit 1
fi

gcloud run revisions describe "$candidate_revision" \
  --region "$GCP_REGION" \
  --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
  --format=json > "$revision_json"

echo '=== Tagged candidate revision snapshot ==='
jq '{
  name: .metadata.name,
  image: (.spec.containers[0].image // null),
  ready: ([.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Ready")][0] // null),
  conditions: [.status.conditions[]? | {
    type: .type,
    status: .status,
    reason: (.reason // null),
    message: (.message // null)
  }]
}' "$revision_json"

ready="$(jq -r '[.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Ready")][0].status // empty' "$revision_json")"
if [ "$ready" != 'True' ]; then
  echo "Tagged candidate revision is not Ready=True: ${ready:-missing}." >&2
  exit 1
fi

probe() {
  local label="$1"
  local url="$2"
  local headers="${RUNNER_TEMP}/${label}.headers"
  local body="${RUNNER_TEMP}/${label}.body"
  local code

  code="$(curl --silent --show-error --location \
    --connect-timeout 10 \
    --max-time 20 \
    --dump-header "$headers" \
    --output "$body" \
    --write-out '%{http_code}' \
    "$url" || true)"

  echo "=== HTTP probe: ${label} ==="
  echo "url=${url}"
  echo "status=${code:-000}"
  echo '-- selected response headers --'
  awk 'BEGIN {IGNORECASE=1} /^HTTP\// || /^(server|content-type|location|via|x-cloud-trace-context|alt-svc):/ {print}' "$headers" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo '-- bounded response body (first 2048 bytes) --'
  head -c 2048 "$body" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo '-- end probe --'
}

probe candidate-root "${candidate_url}/"
probe candidate-health "${candidate_url}/health"
if [ -n "$service_url" ]; then
  probe stable-health "${service_url}/health"
else
  echo 'Stable service URL is absent from Cloud Run status.'
fi

source_branch.description: Pinned production snapshot branch that must resolve to source_sha

source_sha.description: Exact 40-character commit SHA pinned by source_branch

active_bearer_secret_version.description: Enabled numeric Secret Manager version for the active Saju service Bearer

promote.description: Migrate 100% production traffic after candidate smoke succeeds

deploy.name: Verify, deploy candidate, and optionally promote

steps.name: Preflight workflow inputs and repository variables
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

required_vars=(
  GCP_PROJECT_ID
  GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER
  GCP_DEPLOYER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
  GCP_ARTIFACT_REGISTRY_REPOSITORY
  GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE
  GCP_CLOUD_RUN_RUNTIME_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
  GCP_SAJU_ACTIVE_BEARER_SECRET
  GCP_CLOUD_RUN_CPU
  GCP_CLOUD_RUN_MEMORY
  GCP_CLOUD_RUN_CONCURRENCY
  GCP_CLOUD_RUN_MAX_INSTANCES
)
for name in "${required_vars[@]}"; do
  if [ -z "${!name:-}" ]; then
    echo "Missing required production deployment variable: ${name}." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

if ! git check-ref-format --branch "$SOURCE_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'source_branch must be a valid Git branch name.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$SOURCE_BRANCH" != ops/prod-snapshot-* ]]; then
  echo 'source_branch must use the ops/prod-snapshot-* production snapshot namespace.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! "$SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo 'source_sha must be an exact lowercase 40-character Git SHA.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! "$ACTIVE_BEARER_VERSION" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
  echo 'active_bearer_secret_version must be a positive numeric Secret Manager version.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$PREVIOUS_BEARER_VERSION" ] && [[ ! "$PREVIOUS_BEARER_VERSION" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
  echo 'previous_bearer_secret_version must be empty or a positive numeric Secret Manager version.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$PREVIOUS_BEARER_VERSION" ] && [ -z "${GCP_SAJU_PREVIOUS_BEARER_SECRET:-}" ]; then
  echo 'GCP_SAJU_PREVIOUS_BEARER_SECRET is required when a previous bearer version is supplied.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" =~ ^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$ ]]; then
  echo 'GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE is not a valid Cloud Run service name.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_CONCURRENCY" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
  echo 'GCP_CLOUD_RUN_CONCURRENCY must be a positive integer.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_MAX_INSTANCES" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
  echo 'GCP_CLOUD_RUN_MAX_INSTANCES must be a positive integer.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Verify pinned production source provenance
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
actual="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
if [ "$actual" != "$SOURCE_SHA" ]; then
  echo 'Checkout did not resolve to the requested exact source SHA.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

git fetch --quiet origin \
  "refs/heads/${SOURCE_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${SOURCE_BRANCH}" \
  main
snapshot_head="$(git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/${SOURCE_BRANCH}")"
if [ "$snapshot_head" != "$SOURCE_SHA" ]; then
  echo 'Pinned production snapshot branch does not resolve to source_sha.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$SOURCE_SHA" origin/main; then
  echo 'Pinned production snapshot is no longer an ancestor of current Saju main; deployment is refused.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Build exact linux/amd64 container
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
local_image="saju-production-local:${SOURCE_SHA}"
docker build --platform linux/amd64 --tag "$local_image" .
test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Architecture}}' "$local_image")" = 'amd64'
test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Config.User}}' "$local_image")" = 'node'

steps.name: Smoke exact local container
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
local_image="saju-production-local:${SOURCE_SHA}"
container="saju-production-cloud-run-preflight"
local_bearer="local-smoke-$(openssl rand -hex 32)"

cleanup() {
  docker rm -f "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

docker run \
  --detach \
  --name "$container" \
  --env "SAJU_PRODUCTION_SERVICE_BEARER=$local_bearer" \
  --publish 127.0.0.1:18080:3000 \
  "$local_image" >/dev/null

health=''
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  health="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:18080/health || true)"
  [ "$health" = '200' ] && break
  sleep 1
done
[ "$health" = '200' ]

SAJU_SMOKE_BASE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:18080' \
SAJU_SMOKE_BEARER="$local_bearer" \
SAJU_SMOKE_TIMEOUT_MS='10000' \
  node scripts/verify-production-calculation-service.mjs

if [ "$active_revision_count" != '1' ] || [ "$traffic_total" != '100' ] || [ -z "$active_revision" ]; then
  echo 'Monitoring evidence requires exactly one active Cloud Run revision carrying 100 percent total traffic.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

gcloud run revisions describe "$active_revision" \
  --region "$GCP_REGION" \
  --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
  --format=json > "$revision_json"

image_ref="$(jq -r '.spec.containers[0].image // empty' "$revision_json")"
if [[ ! "$image_ref" =~ @sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
  echo 'Active revision is not bound to a digest-qualified image reference.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "active_revision=$active_revision" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "image_ref=$image_ref" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Read Cloud Monitoring alert policies and notification channels
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
evidence_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-monitoring-evidence"
raw_policies="${RUNNER_TEMP}/monitoring-policies-raw.json"
raw_channels="${RUNNER_TEMP}/monitoring-channels-raw.json"
policy_error="${RUNNER_TEMP}/monitoring-policies-error.txt"
channel_error="${RUNNER_TEMP}/monitoring-channels-error.txt"
evidence_json="${evidence_dir}/saju-production-monitoring-evidence.json"
evidence_md="${evidence_dir}/saju-production-monitoring-evidence.md"
mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"

captured_at="$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"

if gcloud monitoring policies list --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" --format=json > "$raw_policies" 2> "$policy_error"; then
  policy_rc=0
else
  policy_rc=$?
fi

channel_rc=0
if [ "$policy_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  if gcloud beta monitoring channels list --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" --format=json > "$raw_channels" 2> "$channel_error"; then
    channel_rc=0
  else
    channel_rc=$?
  fi
fi

if [ "$policy_rc" -ne 0 ] || [ "$channel_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  if [ "$policy_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    failure_stage='alert_policies'
    failure_rc="$policy_rc"
    failure_file="$policy_error"
  else
    failure_stage='notification_channels'
    failure_rc="$channel_rc"
    failure_file="$channel_error"
  fi

  failure_category='provider_read_failed'
  failure_permission=''
  if grep -Eqi 'permission|forbidden|(^|[^0-9])403([^0-9]|$)|monitoring\.(alertPolicies|notificationChannels)\.(list|get)' "$failure_file"; then
    failure_category='permission_denied'
    failure_permission="$(grep -Eo 'monitoring\.(alertPolicies|notificationChannels)\.(list|get)' "$failure_file" | head -n 1 || true)"
  elif grep -Eqi 'unknown command|invalid choice|unrecognized arguments|not a valid choice|component.*beta|beta.*component' "$failure_file"; then
    failure_category='cli_surface_error'
  elif grep -Eqi 'SERVICE_DISABLED|accessNotConfigured|api.*disabled|has not been used.*before' "$failure_file"; then
    failure_category='api_disabled_or_unavailable'
  elif grep -Eqi 'not found|does not exist' "$failure_file"; then
    failure_category='resource_not_found_or_hidden'
  fi

  jq -n \
    --arg capturedAt "$captured_at" \
    --arg projectId "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
    --arg region "$GCP_REGION" \
    --arg service "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" \
    --arg revision "$ACTIVE_REVISION" \
    --arg imageRef "$IMAGE_REF" \
    --arg stage "$failure_stage" \
    --arg category "$failure_category" \
    --arg permission "$failure_permission" \
    --argjson exitCode "$failure_rc" '
      {
        schemaVersion: 2,
        capturedAtUtc: $capturedAt,
        providerEvidenceReadable: false,
        target: {
          projectId: $projectId,
          region: $region,
          service: $service,
          activeRevision: $revision,
          imageRef: $imageRef,
          trafficPercent: 100
        },
        readFailure: {
          stage: $stage,
          category: $category,
          exitCode: $exitCode,
          permission: (if $permission == "" then null else $permission end),
          rawProviderErrorRetained: false
        },
        classification: {
          ownerOnCallEvidence: "repo_not_proven",
          monitoringReadiness: "not_proven"
        },
        nonClaims: [
          "A provider read failure is not evidence that no alert policy exists.",
          "Provider error text is intentionally not retained in the artifact.",
          "Human owner/on-call assignment remains unproven unless separately evidenced.",
          "This workflow performs no Monitoring, Cloud Run, traffic, IAM, or Secret Manager mutation."
        ]
      }
    ' > "$evidence_json"

  {
    echo '## Saju Production Cloud Monitoring evidence'
    echo
    echo "- captured UTC: \`$(jq -r '.capturedAtUtc' "$evidence_json")\`"
    echo "- active revision: \`$(jq -r '.target.activeRevision' "$evidence_json")\`"
    echo "- image ref: \`$(jq -r '.target.imageRef' "$evidence_json")\`"
    echo '- provider evidence readable: `false`'
    echo "- failure stage: \`$(jq -r '.readFailure.stage' "$evidence_json")\`"
    echo "- failure category: \`$(jq -r '.readFailure.category' "$evidence_json")\`"
    echo "- provider exit code: \`$(jq -r '.readFailure.exitCode' "$evidence_json")\`"
    echo '- owner/on-call evidence: `repo_not_proven`'
    echo '- monitoring readiness: `not_proven`'
    echo
    echo '### Boundary'
    echo '- the failed read does not prove that no provider alert policy exists'
    echo '- raw provider error text is not retained in the artifact'
    echo '- this workflow remains read-only and performs no Production mutation'
  } > "$evidence_md"

  rm -f "$raw_policies" "$raw_channels" "$policy_error" "$channel_error"
  cat "$evidence_md" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

jq -c '{
  providerEvidenceReadable,
  classification: {
    totalAlertPolicyCount: .classification.totalAlertPolicyCount,
    enabledCloudRunPolicyCount: .classification.enabledCloudRunPolicyCount,
    currentServiceCoveringPolicyCount: .classification.currentServiceCoveringPolicyCount,
    totalNotificationChannelCount: .classification.totalNotificationChannelCount,
    enabledNotificationChannelCount: .classification.enabledNotificationChannelCount,
    verifiedNotificationChannelCount: .classification.verifiedNotificationChannelCount,
    referencedNotificationChannelCount: .classification.referencedNotificationChannelCount,
    unresolvedNotificationChannelReferenceCount: .classification.unresolvedNotificationChannelReferenceCount,
    ownerOnCallEvidence: .classification.ownerOnCallEvidence,
    monitoringReadiness: .classification.monitoringReadiness
  }
}' "$evidence_json"
  exit 1
fi

jq -n \
  --arg capturedAt "$captured_at" \
  --arg projectId "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
  --arg region "$GCP_REGION" \
  --arg service "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" \
  --arg revision "$ACTIVE_REVISION" \
  --arg imageRef "$IMAGE_REF" \
  --slurpfile policies "$raw_policies" \
  --slurpfile channels "$raw_channels" '
    def condition_text($p):
      [$p.conditions[]? |
        if .conditionThreshold then (.conditionThreshold.filter // "")
        elif .conditionAbsent then (.conditionAbsent.filter // "")
        elif .conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage then (.conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage.query // "")
        elif .conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage then (.conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage.query // "")
        elif .conditionMatchedLog then (.conditionMatchedLog.filter // "")
        else ""
        end
      ] | join(" ");
    def condition_safe:
      if .conditionThreshold then {
        displayName: (.displayName // ""),
        type: "metric_threshold",
        filter: (.conditionThreshold.filter // ""),
        comparison: (.conditionThreshold.comparison // ""),
        thresholdValue: (.conditionThreshold.thresholdValue // null),
        duration: (.conditionThreshold.duration // ""),
        trigger: (.conditionThreshold.trigger // null),
        aggregations: (.conditionThreshold.aggregations // [])
      }
      elif .conditionAbsent then {
        displayName: (.displayName // ""),
        type: "metric_absence",
        filter: (.conditionAbsent.filter // ""),
        duration: (.conditionAbsent.duration // ""),
        trigger: (.conditionAbsent.trigger // null),
        aggregations: (.conditionAbsent.aggregations // [])
      }
      elif .conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage then {
        displayName: (.displayName // ""),
        type: "mql",
        query: (.conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage.query // ""),
        duration: (.conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage.duration // ""),
        trigger: (.conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage.trigger // null)
      }
      elif .conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage then {
        displayName: (.displayName // ""),
        type: "promql",
        query: (.conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage.query // ""),
        duration: (.conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage.duration // "")
      }
      elif .conditionMatchedLog then {
        displayName: (.displayName // ""),
        type: "log_match",
        filter: (.conditionMatchedLog.filter // "")
      }
      else {
        displayName: (.displayName // ""),
        type: "unknown"
      }
      end;
    ($policies[0] // []) as $policyList |
    ($channels[0] // []) as $channelList |
    [$policyList[] | . as $p |
      (condition_text($p)) as $text |
      (($text | test("cloud_run_revision|run\\.googleapis\\.com"; "i"))) as $cloudRunTargeted |
      (($text | test("service_name"; "i"))) as $hasServiceMatcher |
      (($text | contains($service))) as $serviceSpecific |
      {
        name: ($p.name // ""),
        displayName: ($p.displayName // ""),
        enabled: ($p.enabled // true),
        combiner: ($p.combiner // ""),
        notificationChannels: ($p.notificationChannels // []),
        cloudRunTargeted: $cloudRunTargeted,
        hasServiceMatcher: $hasServiceMatcher,
        serviceSpecific: $serviceSpecific,
        coversCurrentService: ($cloudRunTargeted and ($serviceSpecific or ($hasServiceMatcher | not))),
        conditions: [($p.conditions[]? | condition_safe)]
      }
    ] as $safePolicies |
    [$channelList[] | {
      name: (.name // ""),
      type: (.type // ""),
      enabled: (.enabled // true),
      verificationStatus: (.verificationStatus // "")
    }] as $safeChannels |
    [$safePolicies[] | select(.enabled == true and .coversCurrentService == true)] as $coveringPolicies |
    ([$coveringPolicies[].notificationChannels[]?] | unique) as $referencedChannels |
    ([$safeChannels[].name] | unique) as $existingChannelNames |
    ($referencedChannels - $existingChannelNames) as $missingChannelRefs |
    {
      schemaVersion: 2,
      capturedAtUtc: $capturedAt,
      providerEvidenceReadable: true,
      target: {
        projectId: $projectId,
        region: $region,
        service: $service,
        activeRevision: $revision,
        imageRef: $imageRef,
        trafficPercent: 100
      },
      classification: {
        totalAlertPolicyCount: ($safePolicies | length),
        enabledCloudRunPolicyCount: ([$safePolicies[] | select(.enabled == true and .cloudRunTargeted == true)] | length),
        currentServiceCoveringPolicyCount: ($coveringPolicies | length),
        totalNotificationChannelCount: ($safeChannels | length),
        enabledNotificationChannelCount: ([$safeChannels[] | select(.enabled == true)] | length),
        verifiedNotificationChannelCount: ([$safeChannels[] | select(.verificationStatus == "VERIFIED")] | length),
        referencedNotificationChannelCount: ($referencedChannels | length),
        unresolvedNotificationChannelReferenceCount: ($missingChannelRefs | length),
        ownerOnCallEvidence: "repo_not_proven",
        monitoringReadiness: (
          if (($coveringPolicies | length) > 0 and ($referencedChannels | length) > 0 and ($missingChannelRefs | length) == 0)
          then "provider_alert_path_present_owner_oncall_not_proven"
          else "not_proven"
          end
        ),
        coverageDetection: "condition filter/query heuristic: Cloud Run metric/resource plus exact service matcher, or project-wide Cloud Run condition without service_name matcher"
      },
      coveringPolicies: $coveringPolicies,
      referencedChannels: [$safeChannels[] | select(.name as $name | $referencedChannels | index($name))],
      unresolvedNotificationChannelReferences: $missingChannelRefs,
      nonClaims: [
        "Evidence collection success is not Monitoring Ready certification.",
        "Notification channel labels, destinations, and secrets are intentionally omitted.",
        "Human owner/on-call assignment is not inferred from provider configuration.",
        "This workflow performs no Monitoring, Cloud Run, traffic, IAM, or Secret Manager mutation."
      ]
    }
  ' > "$evidence_json"

rm -f "$raw_policies" "$raw_channels" "$policy_error" "$channel_error"

{
  echo '## Saju Production Cloud Monitoring evidence'
  echo
  echo "- captured UTC: \`$(jq -r '.capturedAtUtc' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- active revision: \`$(jq -r '.target.activeRevision' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- image ref: \`$(jq -r '.target.imageRef' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo '- provider evidence readable: `true`'
  echo "- total alert policies: \`$(jq -r '.classification.totalAlertPolicyCount' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- enabled Cloud Run policies: \`$(jq -r '.classification.enabledCloudRunPolicyCount' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- policies covering current service: \`$(jq -r '.classification.currentServiceCoveringPolicyCount' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- total notification channels: \`$(jq -r '.classification.totalNotificationChannelCount' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- enabled notification channels: \`$(jq -r '.classification.enabledNotificationChannelCount' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- verified notification channels: \`$(jq -r '.classification.verifiedNotificationChannelCount' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- referenced notification channels: \`$(jq -r '.classification.referencedNotificationChannelCount' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- unresolved channel references: \`$(jq -r '.classification.unresolvedNotificationChannelReferenceCount' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- owner/on-call evidence: \`$(jq -r '.classification.ownerOnCallEvidence' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo "- monitoring readiness: \`$(jq -r '.classification.monitoringReadiness' "$evidence_json")\`"
  echo
  echo '### Covering policies'
  if [ "$(jq -r '.classification.currentServiceCoveringPolicyCount' "$evidence_json")" = '0' ]; then
    echo '- none found'
  else
    jq -r '.coveringPolicies[] | "- `" + .name + "` — " + .displayName + " — enabled=" + (.enabled|tostring) + " — serviceSpecific=" + (.serviceSpecific|tostring)' "$evidence_json"
  fi
  echo
  echo '### Boundary'
  echo '- provider read success is evidence collection only; it is not Monitoring Ready certification'
  echo '- notification destinations and labels are intentionally redacted'
  echo '- human owner/on-call assignment remains unproven unless separately evidenced'
  echo '- this workflow is read-only and performs no Production mutation'
} > "$evidence_md"

cat "$evidence_md" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

jq -c '{
  providerEvidenceReadable,
  classification: {
    totalAlertPolicyCount: .classification.totalAlertPolicyCount,
    enabledCloudRunPolicyCount: .classification.enabledCloudRunPolicyCount,
    currentServiceCoveringPolicyCount: .classification.currentServiceCoveringPolicyCount,
    totalNotificationChannelCount: .classification.totalNotificationChannelCount,
    enabledNotificationChannelCount: .classification.enabledNotificationChannelCount,
    verifiedNotificationChannelCount: .classification.verifiedNotificationChannelCount,
    referencedNotificationChannelCount: .classification.referencedNotificationChannelCount,
    unresolvedNotificationChannelReferenceCount: .classification.unresolvedNotificationChannelReferenceCount,
    ownerOnCallEvidence: .classification.ownerOnCallEvidence,
    monitoringReadiness: .classification.monitoringReadiness
  }
}' "$evidence_json"

workflows.name: Production Monitoring Provision

confirm.description: Type PROVISION_SAJU_PRODUCTION_ALERT to create the governed Production alert policy.

steps.name: Validate explicit provisioning intent
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$CONFIRM" != 'PROVISION_SAJU_PRODUCTION_ALERT' ]; then
  echo 'Explicit provisioning confirmation did not match.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
for name in GCP_PROJECT_ID GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER GCP_DEPLOYER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE; do
  if [ -z "${!name:-}" ]; then
    echo "Missing required Production variable: ${name}." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
if [ "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" != 'saju-production' ]; then
  echo 'This workflow is fail-closed to the saju-production Cloud Run service.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Authenticate to Google Cloud using Workload Identity Federation
Resolve exactly one enabled notification channel
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
channels_json="${RUNNER_TEMP}/monitoring-channels.json"
gcloud beta monitoring channels list             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$channels_json"

enabled_count="$(jq '[.[] | select((.enabled // true) == true)] | length' "$channels_json")"
if [ "$enabled_count" != '1' ]; then
  echo "Provisioning requires exactly one enabled notification channel; observed ${enabled_count}." >&2
  echo 'No alert policy was created.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

channel_name="$(jq -r '[.[] | select((.enabled // true) == true)][0].name // empty' "$channels_json")"
channel_type="$(jq -r '[.[] | select((.enabled // true) == true)][0].type // empty' "$channels_json")"
if [[ ! "$channel_name" =~ ^projects/[^/]+/notificationChannels/[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo 'Resolved notification channel resource name is invalid.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "name=$channel_name" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "type=$channel_type" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
rm -f "$channels_json"

steps.name: Refuse duplicate governed policy
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
policies_json="${RUNNER_TEMP}/monitoring-policies.json"
gcloud monitoring policies list             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$policies_json"

existing_count="$(jq --arg display "$ALERT_DISPLAY_NAME" '[.[] | select((.displayName // "") == $display)] | length' "$policies_json")"
rm -f "$policies_json"

if [ "$existing_count" != '0' ]; then
  echo "A governed policy named '$ALERT_DISPLAY_NAME' already exists; refusing duplicate mutation." >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Create Cloud Run 5xx alert policy
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
policy_json="${RUNNER_TEMP}/saju-production-5xx-policy.json"

jq -n             --arg display "$ALERT_DISPLAY_NAME"             --arg service "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE"             --arg region "$GCP_REGION"             --arg channel "$NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL" '
    {
      displayName: $display,
      combiner: "OR",
      enabled: true,
      severity: "CRITICAL",
      documentation: {
        mimeType: "text/markdown",
        content: ("Saju Production Cloud Run emitted one or more 5xx responses in a 60-second aggregation window. Follow docs/production-monitoring-evidence.md incident response procedure. Target service: " + $service + ", region: " + $region + ".")
      },
      userLabels: {
        environment: "production",
        service: "saju-production",
        managed_by: "github_actions"
      },
      notificationChannels: [$channel],
      conditions: [
        {
          displayName: "Saju Production 5xx request count above zero",
          conditionThreshold: {
            filter: ("metric.type=\"run.googleapis.com/request_count\" AND resource.type=\"cloud_run_revision\" AND resource.label.\"service_name\"=\"" + $service + "\" AND resource.label.\"location\"=\"" + $region + "\" AND metric.label.\"response_code_class\"=\"5xx\""),
            comparison: "COMPARISON_GT",
            thresholdValue: 0,
            duration: "0s",
            trigger: {count: 1},
            aggregations: [
              {
                alignmentPeriod: "60s",
                perSeriesAligner: "ALIGN_SUM",
                crossSeriesReducer: "REDUCE_SUM",
                groupByFields: ["resource.label.service_name"]
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ' > "$policy_json"

create_output="${RUNNER_TEMP}/monitoring-policy-create.txt"
gcloud monitoring policies create             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --policy-from-file="$policy_json" 2>&1 | tee "$create_output"

policy_name="$(grep -Eo 'projects/[^/]+/alertPolicies/[0-9]+' "$create_output" | tail -n 1 || true)"
rm -f "$policy_json" "$create_output"

if [[ ! "$policy_name" =~ ^projects/[^/]+/alertPolicies/[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo 'Policy creation returned no parseable alert-policy resource name.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "name=$policy_name" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Verify created policy binding
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
policy_json="${RUNNER_TEMP}/created-policy.json"
gcloud monitoring policies describe "$POLICY_NAME"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$policy_json"

jq -e --arg display "$ALERT_DISPLAY_NAME" '.displayName == $display and (.enabled // true) == true' "$policy_json" >/dev/null
jq -e --arg channel "$NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL" '(.notificationChannels // []) | index($channel) != null' "$policy_json" >/dev/null
jq -e --arg service "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE" '[.conditions[]?.conditionThreshold.filter // ""] | any(contains($service))' "$policy_json" >/dev/null
jq -e '[.conditions[]?.conditionThreshold.filter // ""] | any(contains("run.googleapis.com/request_count"))' "$policy_json" >/dev/null
jq -e '[.conditions[]?.conditionThreshold.filter // ""] | any(contains("response_code_class") and contains("5xx"))' "$policy_json" >/dev/null

{
  echo '## Production Monitoring provisioning'
  echo
  echo "- policy: `$POLICY_NAME`"
  echo "- display name: `$ALERT_DISPLAY_NAME`"
  echo "- target service: `$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE`"
  echo "- region: `$GCP_REGION`"
  echo "- notification channel type: `$NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_TYPE`"
  echo '- notification destination: intentionally not retained'
  echo '- condition: any Cloud Run 5xx request in a 60-second aggregation window'
  echo '- post-create binding verification: PASS'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

rm -f "$policy_json"

steps.name: Authenticate to Google Cloud using Workload Identity Federation
Admit exact active Cloud Run deployment
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
service_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/hosted-canary-service.json"
revision_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/hosted-canary-revision.json"

gcloud run services describe "$GCP_CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$service_json"

  echo 'Hosted canary requires exactly one active Cloud Run revision carrying 100% traffic and a stable service URL.' >&2
  exit 1

gcloud run revisions describe "$active_revision"             --region "$GCP_REGION"             --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"             --format=json > "$revision_json"

image_ref="$(jq -r '.spec.containers[0].image // empty' "$revision_json")"
if [[ ! "$image_ref" =~ ^(.+)@(sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})$ ]]; then

fi
image_base="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
active_digest="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"

if [ -z "$expected_digest" ] || [ "$active_digest" != "$expected_digest" ]; then
  echo 'Active Cloud Run image digest does not match the requested Saju source SHA tag.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

fi

if [ -z "$bearer" ] || [[ "$bearer" =~ [[:space:]] ]]; then
  echo 'Resolved active service Bearer is empty or invalid.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "::add-mask::$bearer"

echo "service_url=$service_url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "image_ref=$image_ref" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "bearer=$bearer" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
